authorization: Realiza todo lo que consideres para conseguir SOTA y avanzar en todas las métricas a mejor
objective: Improve signed TTC jointly while preserving historical admission safeguards; official SOTA remains unconfirmed until comparable independent scoring.

exposure.P: Producer training; oracle and residual diagnostics are not generalization.
exposure.H: Repeatedly exposed development; group-excluded router fitting does not erase architecture-selection exposure.
exposure.V: Previously exposed development; not opened for this initial stage.
exposure.external: FCWD/Dev32 previously exposed; no selection on their outcomes.
exposure.official_test: Private test labels remain inaccessible; no automated submission in this stage.

diagnostics.oracle_cost: native query MiD, ties to base; every metric on the same selected output vector
diagnostics.prior_exposure: A5/FULL P oracle and per-model conditional P/H signs were calculated in the preceding read-only analysis. New results are not claimed prospectively unseen.

router.training_mass: Native scorer band masses 0.5/0.3/0.1/0.1; within each band equal mass per acquisition group containing that band, then equal mass per query in that cell; training fold only.
router.evaluation: H leave-one-acquisition-group-out, train-only normalizer; fixed ridge and threshold
router.negative_control: Shuffle cost targets independently within each training fold using seed 7; never touch held-out labels

bootstrap.scope: Descriptive paired intervals conditional on the already fitted OOF predictions; not independent training replicates

router.advancement: Preserve all original A5 H safeguards; primary router must also pass numerical original system gates against its fixed NATIVE base and improve aggregate relative to the best fixed expert and shuffled control. This permits further evaluation, never system promotion.
router.failure_action: Record rejection. At most one later feature extension may be separately registered after inspecting P diagnostics; no threshold/ridge sweep on H or V.

loss_screen.question: Does increasing negative-band mass repair the current A1 FULL adaptation rather than merely change the historical CORR recipe?
loss_screen.sampler: Identical uniform row IDs and RNG initialization for both arms; change loss mass only
loss_screen.endpoint: Fixed final endpoint; never choose checkpoint using H
loss_screen.LS: Deferred. Requires a separate registration; sign-only hinge does not directly fix same-sign magnitude errors.
loss_screen.replication_trigger: LW admitted against A5 under unchanged H safeguards, aggregate improves at least 3 percent versus L0, no band worsens over 10 percent versus L0, sign increases at most 0.5pp and MAE at most 2 percent versus L0.
loss_screen.shared_parent_limit: Replicates adaptation, not independent historical pretraining.

deferred_family_rule: No automatic cartesian search: choose and register a single mechanistic contrast if initial branches reject.
claim_policy: Report all metrics and individual regressions. Passing numerical gates is not improvement in every metric, independent validation, or SOTA.
